doc: A finished clump of flowers, ready to draw and to skin with a flower_v1_pose.

fields.name: height
fields.doc: Height of the tallest stem, metres.

fields.name: bones
fields.doc: Wind bones: 0 is the clump's root, then two per stem.

fields.name: bone_b
fields.doc: Second bone per vertex (smooth bends along a stem).

fields.name: bone_w
fields.doc: Weight of bone_b per vertex (0 = all bone_a).

fields.name: colors
fields.doc: Vertex colour, packed RGBA (red in the lowest byte).
